name: hubertino-mcp
description: Scrape Google Maps business leads (phones, websites, emails, socials) with Hubertino.
long_description: Build lead lists from Google Maps inside Claude and other MCP clients. Start a Hubertino scrape for any business type and location, wait for it, then read the rows (name, category, phone, email, website, address, rating, reviews, social profiles) or save them as CSV/XLSX. Uses your Hubertino API key and credits (1 credit = 1 business delivered). Docs: https://hubertino.com/docs

tools.name: start_scrape
tools.description: Start a Google Maps lead scrape for business categories in locations (uses credits).

tools.name: get_scrape
tools.description: Get a scrape's status, progress, credits and field coverage.

tools.name: wait_for_scrape
tools.description: Wait until a scrape finishes (or a timeout passes) and return its status.

tools.name: list_scrapes
tools.description: List your recent scrapes, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read a scrape's lead rows as compact JSON, page by page, optionally only rows with an email.

tools.name: download_export
tools.description: Save a finished scrape as an XLSX or CSV file on this computer.

prompts.name: build_lead_list
prompts.description: Scrape a business type in an area, wait, and return the leads.
prompts.text: Build me a lead list of "${arguments.business}" businesses in ${arguments.area} using Hubertino: start_scrape, wait_for_scrape, then get_results (emails only: ${arguments.emailsOnly}).

api_url.title: API base URL
api_url.description: Leave as is unless Hubertino support tells you otherwise.
